{{nihongo|'''Obari Shrine'''|尾張神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

{{wikidata link|Q11465315|ja|尾張神社|grok=none|check_date=2026-06-05}}

=== History ===
The date of foundation is unknown. Until the {{ill|Edo period|lt=Edo period|qid=Q184963}}, it was called '''Sannō'''.

Because the location was formerly Kobari Village in {{ill|Kasugai district|ja|春日井郡|pl|Powiat Kasugai|zh|春日井郡|qid=Q11513576}}, and the village name resembled “{{ill|Owari Province|ar|أواري|ca|Província d'Owari|ckb|پارێزگای ئۆوواری|cs|Provincie Owari|de|Provinz Owari|es|Provincia de Owari|eu|Owari probintzia|fa|ولایت اوواری|fi|Owarin provinssi|fr|Province d'Owari|gl|Provincia de Owari|hak|Owari-koet|id|Provinsi Owari|it|Owari (provincia)|ja|尾張国|ko|오와리국|lt|Ovario žemė|nl|Owari (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Owari|pt|Província de Owari|ru|Овари (провинция)|simple|Owari Province|sk|Owari (provincia)|sr|Провинција Овари|tr|Owari (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Оварі|vi|Tỉnh Owari|wuu|尾张国|zh|尾張國|zh_min_nan|Owari-kok|zh_yue|尾張國|qid=Q514506}},” from the Edo period onward it came to be identified with the Shikinaisha “Owari Shrine” of {{ill|Yamada district, Owari|ja|山田郡 (尾張国)|zh|山田郡 (尾張國)|qid=Q11470699|lt=Yamada District}}, and was said to be the place of origin of the name nî|zh_yue|1940年|qid=Q18633}}), the local {{ill|Seinendan|id|Seinendan|ja|青年団|jv|Seinendan|pl|Seinendan|qid=Q9334930}} erected a {{ill|Stele|Q178743|qid=Q178743}} engraved with “Place of Origin of the Name Owari” beside the {{ill|Torii|Q234731|qid=Q234731}}.

However, later research revealed that this area had belonged not to Yamada District but to {{ill|Kasugai district|ja|春日井郡|pl|Powiat Kasugai|zh|春日井郡|qid=Q11513576|lt=Harube District}} since {{ill|Ancient history|Q41493|qid=Q41493}}, and skepticism has grown regarding the theory that identifies this shrine with the Shikinaisha “Owari Shrine,” which should have been located in Yamada District {{Sfn|Moriyama City Board of Education|1963|p=111}}. The territory of Yamada District is thought to have been south of the {{ill|Shōnai River|Q7506182|qid=Q7506182}}, and theories regarding the original “Owari Shrine” include identifying it with Hakusan Shrine in {{ill|Obata-naka|Q42172480|qid=Q42172480}}, {{ill|Moriyama-ku, Nagoya|Q1155291|qid=Q1155291}}, {{ill|Nagoya|Q11751|qid=Q11751}}, or with {{ill|Owari-to Shrine|Q11465305|qid=Q11465305}} in {{ill|Kamishidami, Nagoya|Q52306359|qid=Q52306359}}, the same ward {{Sfn|Moriyama City Board of Education|1963|p=111}}.
